learning_outcomes.text: The student can compile a statement of requirements based on the analysis of business processes of a company of choice.
Based on the drafted statement of requirements, the student can perform a functional analysis for the software to be developed.
Based on the functional analysis, the student can create a technical analysis for the software to be developed.
Based on the technical analysis, the student can set up a set of tests for the software to be developed.

assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a written exam (50%) and lab assignments (50%). For the lab component, reports must be submitted on time. Resit opportunities include partial transfers for successful parts (Theory and Lab) across academic years. For the lab resit, students must improve the existing project from the first evaluation based on guidelines from the lecturer.
